Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Greta passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #29]

Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Clerk."
Constance: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Nisha and Hollis is the Martyr."  [case board: #32, #33]

=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Bartholomew: "Don't trust Lian. My own reading says the people living on the Docks aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #53]
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived); or Bartholomew's Surveyor reading (the night before you arrived)."
Lian: "Merrin belongs at the top of our list. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #54, #24, #26, #55, #56]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Martyr."
Hollis: "Last night, I have given my life over for Greta, should the town ever hang them."  [case board: #57, #58]
Greta: "I don't trust Odette an inch. Constance saw them out at night where someone was killed."  [case board: #59]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Constance pass by."
Odette: "If anyone is keeping score, I don't trust Constance. My own watch saw them out at night where someone was killed."  [case board: #60, #61, #62, #63]
Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Greta passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #29]
Greta: "Bartholomew is right on the money about Lian."  [case board: #30]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Warden."
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Odette about Constance."  [case board: #64, #65]
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Medium."  [case board: #66]

=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Hollis: "While I lack a formal proof as yet, Merrin's conduct strikes me as anomalous."  [case board: #88]
Merrin: "Beware Greta, good neighbors, before it's too late! My reading, taken with the other reports, leaves them among the likeliest."
Merrin: "From my window, I saw Nisha out in the street last night."  [case board: #29, #89]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Gravedigger."
Greta: "Last night, I learned that Constance, whom we hanged, was the Demon."  [case board: #90, #91]
Nisha: "For the record: I did see Hollis out on the Market last night."  [case board: #92]
Agnes: "Oh, Last night, communing with the dead at Fenwick's hearth, I learned nothing they hadn't already told us."
Agnes: "I hate to point a finger, neighbors, yet something doesn't sit right with me about Lian."
Agnes: "From my window, I saw Nisha leave their house on the first night."  [case board: #93, #94, #95]
Lian: "Note this first: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Odette's Night Watch reading (night 1); or Odette's Night Watch reading (the night before you arrived)."  [case board: #96, #62, #61]
